description:
Modding platform for GI, HSR, WW and ZZZ

Features
  One Ring — Allows to launch and manage all supported Model Importers in unified and convenient way
  Plug-and-Play — Configures any supported game and installs its XXMI instance automatically
  Custom Launch — Can be configured to start game in almost every possible way via Advanced Settings
  Automatic Updates — Always keeps XXMI instances and itself up-to date
  Safe to Use — Verifies authenticity of XXMI libraries and own downloads
Supported Model Importers
  WWMI - Wuthering Waves Model Importer GitHub
  ZZMI - Zenless Zone Zero Model Importer GitHub
  SRMI - Honkai: Star Rail Model Importer GitHub
  GIMI - Genshin Impact Model Importer GitHubs
**Available Editions** ([Installation Guide](https://github.com/SpectrumQT/XXMI-Launcher?tab=readme-ov-file#installation)):
• For **Native Windows App** mode download `.msi` installer.
• For **Portable** **or** **Linux** setup download `.zip` version.

[![Support on Patreon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support-PATREON-orange?logo=patreon&logoColor=white)](https://www.patreon.com/SpectrumQT)

## Additions
• **[Launcher]:** Added integration with **Epic Games** and **Steam**. See the **Game Launch** option in the **General** tab.
• **[XXMI]:** Added support for new **XXMI DLL** `d3dx.ini` options in the Model Importer settings tab.
• **[WWMI]:** Added handling for WuWa **Resource Quality** settings.
• **[ZZMI]:** Added detection and notification for duplicate ZZMI libraries in `Mods` folder.
• **[GUI]:** Added indication of enabled logging verbosity level under the **Start** button.

## Adjustments
• **[GUI]:** Moved **Custom Launch** and **Start Method > Manual** to the **Game Launch** option in the **General** tab.
• **[GUI]:** Moved **inject mode selection** from **Custom Launch** to the **XXMI DLL Injection Mode** option in the **[XX]MI** tab.

## Overhauls
• **[GUI]:** Redesigned the settings window layout.
• **[Launcher]:** Significantly reworked the codebase and upgraded the build environment to the latest versions.

## Improvements
• **[Updates]:** **ZIP-channel** updates now respect the built-in proxy and pre-release settings.
• **[Launcher]:** The **XXMI DLL** version now displays the version of the DLL in the MI folder.
    • For non-live or third-party DLL it displays `X.X.X` instead.
• **[Updates]:** Added file integrity verification after unpacking and deployment for better protection against corrupted disks.
• **[Launcher]:** Improved automatic handling of errors caused by an already-open game.

## Removals
• **[WWMI]:** Removed WuWa configuration options that are no longer functional due to changes by Kuro.
• **[WWMI]:** Removed unsupported performance tweaks.

## Bugfixes
• **[Launcher]:** Fixed missing handling of the `Config is missing {setting_name} setting` error caused by invalid `d3dx.ini` file.
• **[GUI]:** Fixed the **Update Available** message remaining stuck in `--nogui` mode until game launch completed.
• **[Launcher]:** Fixed few minor GUI and backend errors.

## Hotfixes
• **[v2.3.9]:** Fixed "**Realtime**" **Process Priority** handling.
• **[v2.4.0]:** Minor GUI fixes and improvements.
• **[v2.4.1]:** Fixed rare ZZZ launch workdir issues and old GUI themes handling.
